description: What one event is trading at on XP -- 'how much are tickets?'. By seat level, floor first: each level's get-in, then each section's rows front to back, a row shown only when it is cheaper than every row in front of it. Prices are all-in per ticket at the party size (quantity). fan_listings counts the fan listings open to offers on the event; their asks are not included. Clubs, suites, obstructed-view and standing-only seats are left out and named in left_out; get_ticket_listings includes them. event_id comes from search_events or search_market.

event_id.description: Event identifier from search_market or search_events.

quantity.description: Party size; filters to groups a buyer can actually transact at.

sections.description: Section names the user named, to report on specifically.
